summary: Targeted frontend retest completed. Both user-dashboard List Property CTAs, the developer banner CTA, and the shared developer Add Project CTA render the requested #5C76D4 with white text; dashboard tab sanity and the light/dark CTA-card regression checks pass. However, #5C76D4 provides only 4.20:1 contrast against white, so the prior WCAG AA issue is improved but not fully resolved for 14px text.

design_issues.screen: User and developer dashboard primary CTA buttons
issues: The requested #5C76D4 background is applied correctly, but its contrast with white is 4.20:1. The CTA labels are 14px at font-weight 500/600, so they still miss WCAG AA's 4.5:1 normal-text threshold. The existing blue-800 #4A5FA8 would provide approximately 6.01:1.

action_items: Use a primary CTA background with at least 4.5:1 contrast against white, such as bg-blue-800 (#4A5FA8), and move hover to bg-blue-900.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPages.jsx lines 72/95 and RoleDashboards.jsx lines 184/265 correctly use bg-blue-700, and live computed styles match the Tailwind palette. The selected palette token itself does not satisfy the accessibility target that prompted this change.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested runtime style and theme-regression checks pass; the original AA contrast objective remains below threshold)

seed_data_creation: None. Existing seeded user and developer accounts were used; no records were created, modified, archived, or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live public preview returned HTTP 200. User login passed; overview and My Listings CTAs computed to rgb(92, 118, 212) with white 14px text and remained visible/actionable. Overview, My Listings, and Profile & Security tabs were clickable. In light mode the CTA card used a light gradient with rgb(15, 23, 42) heading text; in dark mode it used the dark gradient ending rgb(28, 56, 51), with a white heading and rgb(196, 214, 208) subtitle. Developer login passed; after navigating to /developer, dev-banner-add and dev-add-project both computed to rgb(92, 118, 212) with white text. No visible errors or relevant console errors occurred in final runs.
rca_of_the_issue: The class replacements are deployed correctly, but the chosen blue-700 token (#5C76D4) has relative luminance 0.19986, producing (1.05 / (0.19986 + 0.05)) = 4.20:1 against white. This is below the 4.5:1 requirement for the observed 14px CTA labels; blue-800 (#4A5FA8) computes to about 6.01:1.
